an4.140:1.3: atthi bhikkhave vādī atthato pariyādānaṃ gacchati no vyañjanato.
an4.140:1.4: atthi bhikkhave vādī vyañjanato pariyādānaṃ gacchati no atthato.
an4.140:1.5: atthi bhikkhave vādī atthato ca vyañjanato ca pariyādānaṃ gacchati.
an4.140:1.6: atthi bhikkhave vādī nevatthato no vyañjanato pariyādānaṃ gacchati.
an4.140:1.8: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ catūhi paṭisambhidāhi samannāgato bhikkhu atthato ca vyañjanato ca pariyādānaṃ gaccheyyāti.
